<!--
PingMyBell keeps a deliberately small surface: one desktop app, a tiny
fail-open shim, no cloud, no accounts, no telemetry, and no outbound network
calls. Ideas that need a server or a sign-in are not a fit; almost everything
else is fair game. Be honest about scope so the discussion stays grounded.
-->

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? When does it bite — how many agents are
you running, and what did you miss or notice too late? Concrete examples land
better than abstract framings.

## Proposed solution

What would you like PingMyBell to do? If it involves something you'd hear or
see, describe that: what gets spoken, what the island shows, what the board
row looks like.

## Which agent, if any

Is this specific to an agent (Claude Code, Codex CLI, something not yet
supported), or is it core behavior? New agent adapters are meant to be addable
without core changes, so say which hooks or notifications that agent gives you
if you know.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.
